periods.time: During Edelweiss' duel with Eilands-possessed Stella

name.zh: 珠雫将一辉融合进史黛菈体内

periods.location: Burned battlefield above the destroyed Nikko laboratory
periods.summary: Shizuku uses cell-level water magic to send Ikki into Stella's body, giving him a direct path to reach Stella's buried consciousness.
periods.cause: External voices cannot reach Stella through Eilands' control, but Darwin cells prove that living/Device material can be merged into Stella; Shizuku believes she can do the same more safely with Ikki because she knows both bodies intimately.
periods.process: Shizuku absorbs Ikki into herself via Water World to patch her own body enough to move. Edelweiss suppresses Eilands with swordsmanship, Sacred Order and battlefield control, wounding Stella's eyes and buying three seconds. Shizuku charges with Ikki's Intetsu/essence transformed into light, stabs it into Stella's chest, and completes the fusion before Eilands can stop her.
periods.outcome: Ikki's consciousness enters Stella's inner world. Eilands furiously slashes at Shizuku, but Edelweiss pushes her away and takes the wound, allowing the plan to continue.
casualties: Edelweiss' left arm is deeply wounded protecting Shizuku
periods.significance: This is the technical and emotional turning point that makes Stella's recovery possible; Shizuku effectively surpasses Eilands' cell-magic application in the decisive moment.
